I'll search hotels in Paris for those dates and load the relevant city skills.# Paris for two — draft itinerary (10–14 Dec 2026)

**Overview**: Paris 4 nights, one base, no hotel changes | light · standard · standard · standard · light
Note: my city skills cover Japan only, so this Paris plan is built from general planning rules — please double-check opening days and any timed-entry bookings before you go.

**Before you go**
- Book timed-entry slots a few weeks ahead for the Eiffel Tower summit and any museum you care about most (please check availability).
- Many museums close one day a week (often Monday) and most churches close in the evening — check each site's day before you go.
- Get a Navigo Easy card or a carnet of tickets at the airport for metro/bus rides; a single card each is simplest for two people.
- December is cold and dark early (sunset approx. 17:00): pack warm layers and plan indoor stops for late afternoon.
- Reserve one dinner for the two of you a few weeks ahead if you want somewhere special.

**Day 1 | Arrival · Left Bank near the hotel (light)**
- 14:00 CDG Airport → RER B to central Paris, approx. 35–45 min, then metro/walk to the hotel, approx. 15 min, 1 transfer
- 15:30 Check in, unpack, rest
- 17:00 Short walk in the neighbourhood, a café stop
- 19:00 Early dinner near the hotel, early night
- Tonight: Hotel Victoria Paris (巴黎维多利亚酒店)

**Day 2 | Louvre · Tuileries · Seine (standard)**
- 09:00 Walk/metro to the Louvre, approx. 15 min
- 09:30 Louvre (pre-booked slot): start with the quieter wings first
- 12:30 Lunch near Palais Royal
- 14:00 Tuileries Garden and Place de la Concorde, walk approx. 15 min
- 16:00 Orangerie or a covered passage for warmth, approx. 10 min walk
- 18:00 Seine-side walk toward Pont Neuf, lit up and quieter in the evening
- 19:30 Dinner on the Left Bank
- Alternatives: if rain, spend the afternoon in the Louvre or Orsay instead of the garden walk; if tired, drop the Orangerie
- Tonight: Hotel Victoria Paris (巴黎维多利亚酒店)

**Day 3 | Île de la Cité · Latin Quarter · Montmartre evening (standard)**
- 09:00 Notre-Dame area and Sainte-Chapelle, walk approx. 15 min from the hotel
- 11:00 Walk across to the Latin Quarter, approx. 15 min
- 12:00 Lunch in the Latin Quarter
- 14:00 Panthéon or Luxembourg Gardens, approx. 10 min walk
- 16:00 Metro to Montmartre, approx. 25 min, 1 transfer
- 16:30 Sacré-Cœur and the lanes around Abbesses: late afternoon light, fewer people than midday
- 19:00 Dinner in Montmartre
- Alternatives: if rain, swap the Panthéon for the Cluny museum; if tired, drop the Luxembourg Gardens and go straight to Montmartre
- Tonight: Hotel Victoria Paris (巴黎维多利亚酒店)

**Day 4 | Eiffel Tower · Orsay · Marais (standard)**
- 09:00 Metro to Trocadéro, approx. 25 min, 1 transfer
- 09:30 Eiffel Tower views from Trocadéro, then up if you booked a slot
- 12:00 Lunch near the tower
- 13:30 Metro to the Musée d'Orsay, approx. 20 min, 1 transfer
- 14:00 Musée d'Orsay
- 16:30 Walk to the Marais, approx. 20 min, or metro approx. 10 min
- 17:00 Marais stroll and a warm drink
- 19:30 Dinner in the Marais
- Alternatives: if rain, skip Trocadéro and go straight to Orsay, adding the Rodin museum's indoor rooms; if tired, drop the Marais and rest before dinner
- Tonight: Hotel Victoria Paris (巴黎维多利亚酒店)

**Day 5 | Departure (light)**
- 09:00 Breakfast and a last short walk near the hotel only
- 10:30 Check out; metro + RER B to CDG, approx. 50–60 min, 1 transfer — leave plenty of time for check-in

Hotel options I found for your dates are shown above; the draft uses the central, lowest-priced one. Prices are per night as listed and should be re-checked at booking.

items.summary: Closest to the centre of the options found (approx. 1 km from the search point), near the Grands Boulevards area; simple 2-star base, lowest price of the central picks.

items.summary: 4-star with bar, restaurant, terrace and fitness centre in Montparnasse; good for a couple wanting a comfortable base with evening options in the building.
